Offer.Title: Searching the camp

Settings.OnRestHint: After PF2e's Rest for the Night, post a check card for those who rested.
Settings.SkillHint: survival by default; any skill slug (perception …).
Settings.DcModeHint: Level-based DC (GM Core) or a fixed number.
Settings.WeightsHint: Common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary. Default 70,18,8,3.5,0.5 (any total; used as ratios).
Settings.CostHint: Write it with units: '1 sp', '2 gp 5 sp', '1.5 gp' (a bare number is cp). By level: the level-1 cost (1 sp → 1 gp at level 10).
Settings.MaxHint: Not counting the free first spin. A critical success adds a free one.
Settings.CashHint: Coins instead of the item = its value × this. 0 hides the button.
Settings.BroadcastHint: When someone spins, the same wheel spins on everyone's screen (one after another, with the character's face and name).
Settings.CostModeHint: Coins are worth less at higher levels, so by default the cost follows the level.
Settings.CostTableHint: 'level: amount', comma separated (1: 1 sp, 5: 5 sp, 10: 1 gp); from that level up.
Settings.KeepHint: 'Pick': choose one of the pulls. 'Last': a re-spin throws away what came before; only the new pull can be taken.
Settings.MachineHint: The machine on the card after rest. 'Player's choice': each picks on the card (the GM button asks when offering).
Settings.SkillOtherHint: A skill slug (thievery, perception, deception, society …). The roulette uses 'Check' above.
Settings.SlotRateHint: The roulette's re-spin cost × this (default 0.5 — cheap, many tries).
Settings.HlRateHint: Each guess costs the roulette's re-spin cost × this. 0 (default): free — the pot is the stake.
Settings.HlTieHint: When the next card has the same rank.
Settings.QueueHint: When several have a chance at once they line up; when the one playing takes their find or closes the window, the next one's window opens. Needs a GM online.
Settings.TurnTimeoutHint: If the one playing doesn't spin for this long, the turn moves on (the chance stays). Players who went offline are skipped.
Settings.HlRungsHint: Right guesses in a row for the pot to go a tier up (default 2 — eight in a row from common to legendary).
Settings.AfterCombatHint: When combat ends, the player characters in it get a 'Battle loot' chance card. (After a night's rest: 'Camp forage'.)

Slot.Hint: Pull the lever and stop the reels yourself (Space: next reel). They stop on their own if you wait.

HL.Hint: Draw a card for your first pot (a find). Each right guess on the next card is a rung up; every two rungs the pot becomes a find a tier higher. One wrong guess and the pot is gone — a bite of food is all you keep. Knowing when to stop is the game.
HL.CritBonus: Critical success: insurance — one miss won't cost the pot 🛡
HL.BustLine: {name} went empty-handed on guess {n} at High & Low.
HL.WonLine: {name} stopped at rung {n} of High & Low and took the pot
HL.Rules: A real 52-card deck · ace low, king high · no card comes back · same rank: the house wins · red/black all-in: two rungs
HL.AllInHint: Guess just the colour of the next card for two rungs at once. Wrong loses the pot all the same.
HL.Pot: The pot (stop now and it's yours)
HL.ConsolationLine: {name} climbed to rung {rung} at High & Low and lost the pot. A consolation bite is all that's left.
